Title: To Faithfully Reign

Verses.1:
I will sing of mercy and justice; [*]
	to You, LORD, I will sing.
Verses.2:
I will carefully consider the blameless way. [*]
	When will You come to me?

I will walk with a blameless heart [*]
	in the midst of my house.
Verses.3:
I will not set anything worthless before my eyes. [t]
	I hate the work of those who fall away; [*]
	it will not cling to me.
Verses.4:
A perverse heart shall leave me; [*]
	I will not know evil.
Verses.5:
Whoever secretly slanders their neighbor, [*]
	I will silence them.
Whoever has a haughty look and an arrogant heart, [*]
	I will not endure them.
Verses.6:
My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, [t]
	that they may dwell with me. [*]
	The one whose walk is blameless will serve me.
Verses.7:
No one who practices deceit will dwell within my house. [*]
	No one who speaks lies will stand before me.
Verses.8:
Every morning I will silence all the wicked in the land, [*]
	to cut off all from the city of the LORD who do injustice.
